terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.description: Vite frontend dev server for NiroVera/PowerCare on http://localhost:5173. Serves the React app against the hosted Base44 backend when VITE_BASE44_APP_ID and VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL are set in .env.local; otherwise the UI renders but /api calls have no backend. For a full local backend, run `base44 dev` instead (requires Base44 CLI + auth).
